[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]On-demand memory web rosters — read the decisions roster when [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]planning, not on every turn[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Any memory web can declare `roster_loading: on_demand`. Agent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instruction bundles and the committed AGENTS.md then carry a short [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]generated pointer instead of the full roster. The pointer names the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exact audited command and lists who MUST run it: planners and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]researchers, plus anyone changing governed behavior without a plan.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The command is `sase memory read roster:<web>`, it batches with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]strand reads, and the TUI shows it in the agent MEMORY lane and on [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the Memory panel's web card. A bare read of an on-demand web can no[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]longer dump every strand body by accident. The decisions webs in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sase and bob-cli adopt it, so the decisions section drops from [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]about 8.4 KB to about 0.8 KB in sase and from about 25.6 KB to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]about 1 KB in bob-cli. bob-cli's Codex bundle goes from over its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cap to roughly 19 KB of headroom.[/#D7D7AF]
